law: FI may show all public repo issues. FIELD PLAY only selects play_safe=true issues; local/private/sensitive holds remain visible as repo truth but are not contributor missions.

issues.title: Converge FOLD//BLOOM Weave + make Scale Lens an aperture, without capability loss
issues.body:
## Objective

Advance two coupled-but-distinct fronts without deleting recovered capability.

### A — FOLD//BLOOM convergence
- Preserve exact recovered donor: `/recovery/fold-bloom/fold-weave-0.1/`.
- Surface Fold Weave 0.1 prominently enough to actually play/test it.
- Treat authored persistent CREASE topology as the selected experimental transfer into the living FOLD//BLOOM line.
- Preserve Ecology 0.2 as an ancestor/comparison specimen; do not silently replace or delete it.
- Recover/retain valuable later FOLD//BLOOM mechanics (Garden, ecology/temperament, lineage, breeding/grafting, memory, archaeology, Law/Style labs, RETURN) while dropping only demonstrated duplication/superfluous presentation.
- Do not merge Two Dial / Instrument back into the ecology line merely for taxonomy.

### B — Scale Lens aperture + UX
- Preserve RC11.2 deep capability. No feature culling.
- Make the interface visibly easier to parse on desktop and mobile.
- Hard-edge/square control language: square buttons, reduced decorative rounding, clearer hierarchy and spacing.
- Promote stable address / source / projection / RETURN as the primary reading path.
- Extend the existing global `showcase-nav.js` adapter with a LENS action.
- Allow a current same-origin page or contract JSON to open in Scale Lens with a return address.
- Field Intake → Lens → inspect → RETURN should work.
- Contract JSON → Lens human-readable hierarchy → RAW remains available.
- Keep deep Studio as the laboratory; add simpler access in front rather than deleting advanced panels.

## Recovered evidence / constraints
- `restore-fold-weave-exact` exists; exact Fold Weave source was corrected/restored on 2026-09-20 after an earlier 317-line truncation.
- `control/FOLD_WEAVE_PROMOTION_2026-09-20.json` selects `AUTHORED_CREASE_TOPOLOGY_KERNEL` as `EXPERIMENTAL_SELECTABLE_MODE`, not wholesale donor replacement.
- Scale Lens already recognizes `poly.ingress/v0.4`, preserves Field Intake canonical IDs/provenance, and can return upstream.
- Existing global route adapter is already the correct substrate for a small Lens aperture.

## Do not touch
- Exact recovered donor bytes except for a separate clearly-derived branch.
- Ecology 0.2 frozen specimen.
- RC11.2 parser/address/provenance/receipt/deep projection machinery.
- RETURN semantics.

## Acceptance
1. Fold Weave is reachable from a meaningful FOLD//BLOOM surface and clearly labelled recovered/current candidate.
2. Ecology 0.2 remains reachable and identified as retained ancestor/comparison.
3. Scale Lens is visibly hard-edged/square and more legible without capability removal.
4. Every showcase surface can invoke LENS through the existing route adapter.
5. Same-origin JSON contract can load directly in Lens.
6. Lens can return to the invoking route.
7. Existing raw JSON paths remain available.
8. Relevant FIELD INDEX timestamps/work modes are updated per `/control/FIELD_INDEX_CONTRACT.json`.
9. Return with tested URLs/screenshots or explicit failure receipts.

## Worker split
**Hermes:** recover lineage, compare lost mechanics, identify omissions/regressions, produce bounded packets/QA. Read-only unless authority is explicitly expanded.

**Codex:** bounded repo mutation + tests + receipts.

**Human:** comparative play only where behavior cannot be decided from code/evidence (MIRROR vs CREASE default).

issues.title: Representation 01 · One object across five projections
issues.body:
## Goal
Use the recovered ONE RETURN / SEAM ENGINE v0.2 as the substrate for one concrete cross-projection fixture.

## Candidate projections
- Scale Lens
- Fold/Bloom
- Atlas Dayline / Aperture
- Painting / Path
- plain list baseline

## Required contract
For one shared object, state:
- PRESERVES
- HIDES
- PERMITS
- ROUND_TRIP
- PLAIN_BASELINE
- TEST
- RETURN

## Done when
One object can be selected/inspected across all surviving projections with stable identity, and at least one projection proves a task advantage rather than ornamental difference.

## Do not
Do not merge the interfaces into one mega-screen.

issues.title: Print 01 · Digital → stencil/proof → physical → RETURN
issues.body:
## Goal
Reify the print/proof mechanisms already present in Cassette Atlas / House OS materials.

## Loop
canonical object/state
→ SVG/PDF plate
→ print/sticker/stencil/template
→ physical placement/use
→ photo/measurement/observation
→ RETURN receipt

## Candidate first fixture
One address strip / route tile / tool label / stencil with:
- stable ID
- scale
- registration
- revision
- source pointer
- manual fallback

## Done when
The physical artifact can be traced back to exact digital source and the observed physical consequence returns to the ledger.

issues.title: Recovery HOLD · Naming / glyph / Game-of-Names lineage
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / RECOVER-WHEN-PAYOFF. This is deliberately not a fourth live front.

## Goal
Locate exact artifacts/notes around naming systems, Game of Names, glyph/seal protocols, semantic identity and related experiments; preserve lineage and identify mechanisms that belong in current language/address tooling.

## Questions
- Which artifacts are exact runnable/source specimens?
- Which naming operations preserve referent/identity across transforms?
- What belongs with Verse/Path, what belongs with seals/glyphs, and what is a separate game/instrument?
- Which branches are merely aesthetic shells?

## Done when
A small lineage map and recovery entries exist; no new mega-app is invented.

issues.title: Census · Cluster Sep 05–19 Library artifacts
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn the recent Library/file explosion into a deduplicated recovery census.

## Method
1. inventory exact files and hashes
2. group exact duplicates
3. group near versions by lineage/name/content
4. classify HEAD / DONOR / RECOVER / QUARANTINE / SUPERSEDED
5. add only distinctive runnable/source artifacts to the migration ledger

## Priority clusters already visible
- Fold/Bloom / fold-weave
- AXIAL / state-transform
- ENV0 / House OS physical boards
- generated visual/reference batches
- Foundry / Grid Path / Verse Atlas
- Sleeper checkpoints

## Receipt
A machine-readable census plus counts by class; no source deletion.

issues.title: Pipeline HOLD · Messaging/account cleanup + autoresponder substrate
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / research and inventory. Do not send, delete, archive, label or mutate accounts from this task.

## Goal
Map the eventual communication substrate across email and messengers as one policy-governed intent/event/RETURN system rather than one bot per channel.

Recover/define:
- account/channel identities
- person/resource policies
- read/remember/acknowledge/draft/act/escalate gates
- thread/message canonical IDs
- drafts vs sent actions
- autoresponder templates/decision traces
- audit/RETURN

## Immediate output
Connector/tool availability map + read-only inventory plan + one bounded Gmail proof candidate.

No all-messenger automation until each channel has explicit authority and rollback semantics.

issues.title: Adapter HOLD · Body / health / anatomy state projection
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / adapter research only. Do not make this a live front.

## Goal
Recover the transferable structure used in health/body/case consolidation without importing private medical content.

Candidate canonical concepts:
- anatomical address / region
- observation vs interpretation
- event / intervention
- evidence confidence
- chronology
- state delta
- residue / unresolved
- RETURN

## Safety
Observation != diagnosis. Confidence/source must remain explicit.

## Done when
A privacy-safe Domain Pack/schema exists and can project into plain chronology, body map, training view, and printable reference without changing canonical identity.

issues.title: Reality 01 · One physical before→change→after RETURN
issues.body:
## Goal
Keep the abstraction stack reality-gated by completing one bounded physical/home transformation.

## Contract
Pick one zone or owned endpoint → record before-state → make one reversible change → record after-state → state what became easier/measurably different.

## Bounds
No new hardware purchase required. No expansion into a full House OS architecture.

## Receipt
Before/after evidence + one paragraph/JSON record of the state delta.
